evaluation_scope.name: frozen_shared_evaluation_sources_v1
evaluation_scope.policy: Same reviewed development plus evaluation source windows and direct references for all four modes; no labels or reference answers.

protocol.overlap_policy: report overlap retained and disclosed; final/development question evidence assignments remain frozen and disjoint
protocol.warmup: one per mode, excluded from measured runs
protocol.secondary_review: five questions across four modes, or delayed 25 percent re-score
protocol.packing_policy: same conservative 3000 UTF-8 byte cap in every mode; below designed token ceiling
protocol.mode_label_policy: retain frozen MODE prompt field; mode differences are not purely retrieval effects
protocol.isolation: source text and split IDs only; no gold triples or reference answers in processing
protocol.tuning_policy: no prompt, selector, generation, retrieval or embedding tuning from held-out results
protocol.extraction_scoring: score frozen model predictions before review filtering and fusion; preserve rejected predictions, failures and empty windows
protocol.graph_policy: source-only reviewed Supported assertions, with excluded dispositions retained separately
protocol.error_policy: retain failures and undefined metrics; do not substitute modes or scores
protocol.analysis: paired question-level comparisons; 10000 question-cluster bootstrap samples; exploratory 95 percent intervals

warmup_question: According to CISA, how do Rhysida actors use valid accounts (T1078) for access? Explain the supplied ATT&CK mitigation guidance and cite the sources separately.
latency_policy: Initialize all retrievers/vector bindings before warmups. Measured case time covers retrieval, packing, generation/repair and initial answer/evidence persistence; excludes setup, file/model guards and final timing/receipt updates. Record retrieval_ms and generation_ms separately.
resume_policy: Skip valid terminal measured answers, abstentions and failures; rerun only interrupted/unstarted measured cases. Each resumed operator launch repeats four excluded warmups before unfinished measurements. Preserve every warmup/run/attempt.
scope_policy: All modes use the same fixed reviewed source/reference scope; generator and retrieval settings unchanged.
reference_isolation: Only id, question and category are exported from the benchmark; only question/mode/corpus_version reach QueryRequest.
